  Scenario: AC11 The rules BR7 to BR11 hold on the proposal path (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given treatment T-1001 holds a proposal asked with the key TDR_OFFER:T-1001
    When "suggestTdrOffer" asks again for treatment T-1001 with the same key
    Then the stored answer is returned and no record and no outbox row is written
    Then the stage reports the target state of the rule it took and the treatment state stays in the state column of this service
    Then the band, the wait, the model code and version, the prompt version, the policy version and the lists are read as values in force with their version
    Then a role without Treatment and offer R asking for the proposal is refused by the guard library with 403 and MSG-P4-002
    Then no rwb_source_data or v_ace_* read is made and the request carries the treatment's own facts only

  Scenario: AC12 An unauthenticated call is answered 401 and an unknown treatment is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the provided operations of this service are the suggestion operation and the proposal read
    When a call reaches either operation without a valid token
    Then the answer is 401 and no proposal is read or written
    And a proposal read for a treatment ID that does not exist is answered 404
